Where can I watch NBC News NOW? – NBC News Group

content.text:
If you want **MSNBC live streaming free online**, the legal options are limited:

- **Official MSNBC/MS NOW live stream:** available online, but **unlimited live streaming requires signing in with a supported TV provider**. MSNBC has rebranded as **MS NOW** in recent listings/support pages. ([nbcnews.zendesk.com](https://nbcnews.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45174697854227-How-do-I-watch-MSNBC-live-on-the-internet?utm_source=openai))  
- **Official page:** search for **“MSNBC live”** or **“MS NOW live”** and use the official MSNBC/MS NOW/NBC page—not random “free TV” sites.
- **Free alternative:** **NBC News NOW** is a free live news stream available through many apps/platforms, but it is **not the same as MSNBC/MS NOW**. ([nbcnews.zendesk.com](https://nbcnews.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45174657963155-Where-can-I-watch-NBC-News-NOW?utm_source=openai))
- **Free trials:** live-TV services such as **YouTube TV, Hulu + Live TV, DirecTV Stream, Fubo, or Sling** may carry MSNBC/MS NOW, but availability, prices, and trials change frequently.

I’d avoid unofficial “free MSNBC stream” sites—they’re often unreliable, full of ads, or unauthorized.
